title: Several Check Point products: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 46 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.8). The exploit prediction score is 92%.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 25, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
